title: Semantic diffing of formal policies with anti-unification
summary: A textual diff of two formal policies flags every cosmetic change and hides the one that alters behavior. This post shows how to compute a symbolic, deterministic semantic diff with an open-source anti-unification engine, so reviewers see only the genuine disagreements between tw
